newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Red Box to buy power concession holder.
newsitem.headline: Red Box to buy power concession holder.

text.p: Red Box (Malaysia) Bhd has proposed to acquire the entire paid-up capital of Usaha Sama Timur Barat Sdn Bhd (USTB), a power project concession holder, for 616 million ringgit.
A statement issued by the company's bankers on Friday said the acquisition will be satisfied by the issue of 88 million new Red Box shares valued at 7.0 ringgit each.

USTB was awarded a contract to build and operate three power plants in Kazakhstan under a 60-year concession period. Under the agreement, USTB will sell all electricity generated by the plants, which will have a total capacity of 670 megawatts, to the Kazakhstan government at a minimum rate of $0.065/kilowatt hour and $0.05/kilowatt hour for hydro and wind power energy production respectively.
USTB will also be assigned to all the net profit amounting to not less than $62.1 million a year from the existing Kapchagay Hydro Electric Power Station for seven years.
The project is estimated to cost $786 million. The statement said USTB has informed Red Box that an Australia-based fund management company has offered to fund the cost.

The vendors of USTB, who will directly hold 57.52 percent of Red Box's enlarged capital on completion of the acquisition, intend to seek a waiver from having to make a mandatory general offer for the remaining Red Box shares they do not own.

The statement said the acquisition would allow Red Box, a loss-making photo album manufacturer, to diversify from its core business and to participate in a foreign privatisation project which will provide continuous income stream throughout the 60-year concession period.
Shares of Red Box, which have been suspended since October 8, were last traded at 7.0 ringgit.
